cells.scene: A delighted child receives a special slice of cake from an adult at a cafe table, small rare pleasure.
A city resident leans from their apartment window above an ordinary urban street, daily residence context.
An exhausted hiker walks unsteadily on a level path, torso tilted and feet irregularly placed, a friend nearby ready to assist.
An unusual tropical orchid with vivid petals and a distinctive shape is displayed beside familiar plain daisies.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — treat (n.难得的乐事，享受): A delighted child receives a special slice of cake from an adult at a cafe table, small rare pleasure.
TOP RIGHT — dweller (n.居住者): A city resident leans from their apartment window above an ordinary urban street, daily residence context.
BOTTOM LEFT — stagger (v.摇晃，蹒跚): An exhausted hiker walks unsteadily on a level path, torso tilted and feet irregularly placed, a friend nearby ready to assist.
BOTTOM RIGHT — exotic (a.异乎寻常的，外来的): An unusual tropical orchid with vivid petals and a distinctive shape is displayed beside familiar plain daisies.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: All scenes passed course meaning, anatomy and crop review. Treat is a pleasurable cake; stagger shows exhausted unsteady steps; exotic contrasts an unusual orchid with familiar daisies; descend follows a downward sequence; tuck is a parent tucking in a child; obstinately is a stubborn refusal to leave.
